Method of Attack: Deployment of backdoors allowing recording audio via host microphone, taking desktop screenshots, logging and exfiltrating keystrokes, downloading and executing additional .exe and .dll payloads
Attack Vector: Phishing messages carrying self-extracting 7-Zip archives fetching XML files from xsph.ru subdomain
HTM attachments sent from compromised email accounts
Modification of Normal.dotm Microsoft Word template file with malicious macros
Indicators of Compromise: Use of legitimate remote desktop tools Ammyy Admin and AnyDesk
